items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: He had Joe -- Joe Thomas, Joe Thomas was on -- was there with him... And he called me and asked me, are you coming to make it.

ctx.x: Uh-huh, and he called me. He had Joe -- Joe Thomas, Joe Thomas was on -- was there with him, and had been -- Joe -- well Joe is Joe, you know. He's a hell of a trumpet player. He -- you've got to give it to him. He's -- well, when he has too many tastes, you know, he's another guy, and I think that's what had happened.
And he called me and asked me, are you coming to make it. And -- well I -- at that time I had -- since I'd been home, I hadn't been on the road since I had this broken hip.

items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: So the cat sitting next to you might have been a cat like Herman Autrey, he says, man, don't tell him you don't drink.

ctx.x: Don't leave out Herman Autrey. I always thought of Joe Louis.
